note: (1) 'Jacques Casorti' in the brief is August (Auguste) Casorti, 1812-1908 (IMSLP), who also appears as 'Alessandro' on IMSLP; his nephew Alessandro (1830-67) wrote concertos. IMSLP holds Op. 50 (Bogentechnik, 1880), Op. 61 (158 double-stop exercises), Op. 47 and Op. 60; the works list also names Op. 41, 54 and 62 (Rasche Tonleitern), which I could not see. (2) Nothing technical found for César Thomson (BnF's 'Méthode technique', Gallet 1922, is by Eugène Thomson and Louis Fournier and is listed), Jules Garcin, Maurice Hewitt, Henri/J. Berthelier (only J. Berthelier's 1913 scale booklet), Gaillard, Kantorow, Serrato, Conus, Louis Blanc; Léon Firket wrote a viola method. Habeneck, Cartier, Baillot's Méthode and L'art du violon are general methods/treatises (skipped, with Baillot's playable études listed). No études or school of his own by Viotti turned up in IMSLP or BnF. (3) Almost no syllabus data exists for this slice, so level_guess is my judgement from IMSLP/BnF descriptions; 'medium' = existence solid but level inferred, 'low' = thin evidence (BnF record only, title only). Strongest evidence: Heim's Gradus ad Parnassum (IMSLP gives exact contents), Crickboom's Maîtres (positions and composers), Essek (IMSLP says between Rovelli and Gaviniès), Chemla and Lacour (Billaudot 'degré'). (4) The modern French series (Doukan, 14 cahiers; Erlih; Nérini; Van de Velde) were found through BnF records only; Doukan and Billaudot items were confirmed on billaudot.com. First-position opening volumes (Doukan Cahier 1, Crickboom Book 1) are kept at L1 on the Wohlfahrt Op. 45 precedent; Heim Book 1 ('elementary') and Courvoisier Vols 3-4 are left out. Gammes pratiques (Nadaud) is sold by Billaudot as 'Bozza / Nadaud' and BnF lists a 1943 Costallat edition under Bozza. (5) BnF also lists dozens of minor 1873-1940 French scale/exercise booklets; I listed the better documented ones and put the rest in 'skipped'. No Dutch (KB) or Swiss national-library check was possible, so Dutch/Swiss coverage is IMSLP + BnF only. (6) scripts/expand/imslp_author.py silently truncates any author with more than 500 category members because IMSLP's API answers with 'query-continue', not 'continue'; irrelevant here, but it will cut off prolific composers. (7) Overlaps with other researchers' files, for the merge: Casorti Opp. 50/61, Marteau Opp. 14/19/25, Heim Gradus and Courvoisier (german_a/b), Libon and Monasterio (italian_baroque), Baillot Op. 2 (franco_a, also L5). Crickboom's La Technique du violon is named in Italian conservatory syllabi (lead from italian_baroque). Crickboom's Maîtres is reissued by Schott Music (Book 2 = SF 6587 on boullard.ch). (8) Existing catalogue rows for these authors are all non-technical (Viotti concertos/duos, Pauline Viardot pieces, Conus, Accolay, Leclair, Senaillé arr. Moffat), so no existing_issues. WebSearch used twice (Casorti/Capet levels; Doukan contents): no grading found; billaudot.com grades only Doukan Cahier 1 (moyenne difficulté, cycle 2).
